              キーワード
              学習・教育目標

              1.Design of psychological experiments
2.Psychological measurement

              The purpose of psychological experiments is to find general principles of psychological behavior under strictly controlled conditions. The objectives of this course are to learn about the measurement methods necessary for planning psychological experiments and to acquire the methodological framework of psychology as a science.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              Psychological research carries the risk of misunderstanding psychological mechanisms because everyday experiences are influenced by many factors. To avoid this risk, psychologists have developed their own scientific methodology for using various methods to conduct objective measurements. This course prepares students to design their own experiments and provides basic knowledge of factorial design and method of measurement.

              教科書および参考書・リザーブドブック

              none

              履修に必要な予備知識や技能

              This course focuses on factorial design and measurement of psychological methods. Students are required to learn the relationships between the courses of "psychological statistics" and "psychological methods".
